proof_authority: Requested proof scope is evaluator-owned and frozen into the request; adapters can no longer promote HARNESS_SELF_TEST evidence to PRODUCT_LIVE.
HARNESS_SELF_TEST remains product_claim_status NOT_TESTED even when all ten journeys pass.
PRODUCT_LIVE fails closed without an evaluator-validated observer registration bound to a canonical artifact hash; the observer interface is subprocess-only and implementation-independent.
The observer registry is frozen (empty in this slice), so the live route deterministically rejects claims while exposing the external observer contract.
PRODUCT_LIVE source identity requires an independently observed non-file system reference; run-root files are evidence copies only.
Actor and verifier identities are evaluator-issued; distinct self-asserted strings are insufficient.
status_semantics: Every non-PASS journey status requires a strict status-detail object with controlled reason code, human-readable explanation, and criterion-specific evidence references.
BLOCKED requires a concrete unavailable external dependency, observation proving unavailability, retry policy, and unblock condition.
WAITING requires a durable wait event, event source, resume condition, and bounded next-check or event-driven resumption semantics.
NOT_TESTED names the exact unexecuted criterion IDs and cannot coexist with evidence claiming those criteria passed.
FAIL identifies the failed criterion or protocol/implementation reason; PASS cannot carry a non-PASS status detail; unknown fields and dangling evidence IDs are rejected.
